base_member_text: [L127-L129] (MED/configuration-path) MPI_Debug|x64 writes module files to bin\bmi\win32\$(ConfigurationName) while its output/object paths are x64, mixing architecture-specific module artifacts.
audit_member_text: [L128] (MED/configuration-contamination) MPI_Debug|x64 places generated modules in the win32 BMI directory instead of its x64 directory.

adversarial.rationale: The BMI x64 debug configuration explicitly writes modules into the exact Win32 BMI directory used by MPI_Debug|Win32. xbeach_bmi.f90 actually declares module xbeach_bmi and has no file-level configuration override; the correct x64 object and output paths therefore do not prevent this shared module destination.
